snippet.title: How Intel Lost the CPU Race..
snippet.description:
Intel's been the lead CPU chipmaker for decades, but it looks like that win streak is finally coming to an end..
The Final Nail in Intel's Coffin.. RIP (Amazon) ➡ http://geni.us/tzSVjb

Why Apple MacBooks are so expensive ➡ https://youtu.be/xgi90BxwyjA
New 2019 MacBooks are HERE - MacBook Buyer's Guide ➡ https://youtu.be/Y2Ydw9L7R9Y
iPad Pro Review after iPadOS 13 ➡ https://youtu.be/yBxvZ-_rOY4
Buying a 2019 MacBook Pro? Don't make these 10 mistakes ➡ https://youtu.be/MB19THTFbxI

Intel processors have been enjoying the bulk of the market share for many decades, but AMD has been fighting strong with it's Ryzen & Threadripper CPUs.

In 2013, Intel claimed they would have their 10nm CPU processors ready in 2015, but we're now in 2019, and 10nm Ice Lake processors have yet to ship.

AMD's recent 3rd-gen Ryzen 3 series and 3900X chips have put a TON of pressure on Intel.

And in the meantime, Apple and their A-line chips, especially the A12X processor have been getting incredible powerful using ARM technology and TSMC's 7nm process.

Other brands like Samsung's Exynos and Qualcomm's Snapdragon have also been pushing forward with their mobile ARM chips and they've been getting increasingly more powerful with every release.

Intel is starting to get into some really deep trouble.
